Downloads the Linux build of Project Zomboid into Downloads/zomdroid — no Termux, no PC. Build 41 is ~6–7 GB and Build 42 ~10–11 GB unpacked, so it takes a long time; if interrupted, just start the same build again and it resumes. Leave the manifest field blank for the latest build. To pin an older version instead, find it at https://steamdb.info/depot/108603/manifests/ and copy its \"DepotDownloader\" line (not \"Steam Console\") — paste the whole line here, branch included; the Build 41/42 toggle above is then ignored.
Manifest id, or a full DepotDownloader line (blank = latest)

Download Workshop mods by ID (the number in the workshop URL: …/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=NUMBER). No Steam login needed. Several IDs can be space-separated. Each is saved as a .zip in Downloads/zomdroid.

The game and mods are saved into the public Downloads/zomdroid folder so you can see, share and import them. Please grant \"All files access\" to Zomdroid, then tap Download again.

Lowers texture detail when memory runs low. Helps avoid crashes on devices with 8 GB RAM or less; not needed with 12 GB. Applies to the NG_GL4ES renderer on Build 42.

• Quick Save (F10) — a real backup of your world you can return to after a crash or a death. Turn it on in Settings → Features and read the note there. The F10 button ships with the new control layouts; on a layout from an older version, add it yourself in the controls editor: input type MNK, binding KEY_F10.

• Fixed a bug with joining some multiplayer servers — the join screen no longer freezes with unclickable buttons.

• Animated mods are now supported — mod vehicles and hairstyles sit where they should: each game build now uses its own model importer.

• Suggested presets — one tap in Settings applies the renderer, texture shrinking and Java arguments that fit your device and game build. ZINK now detects your GPU and starts with the matching Vulkan driver.

• NG_GL4ES updated to v40 — black areas, car glitches and map fps drops fixed, faster on Mali.

• The Steam downloader downloads the game much faster.

• LIBGL_SHRINK made easy — a selector with a reference table for NG_GL4ES texture shrinking, right in Settings.

• Touchpad — tap-to-click can now be turned off, so an accidental tap while moving the cursor doesn't click things.

Technical: LT/RT input fixes, gamepad mapper polish, better bug report logs.

Full changelog:
https://github.com/udarmolota/zomdroid/releases

Pressing F10 makes a full copy of your world — a point you can return to after a crash or a death.

The bigger your save (the longer your character has lived), the longer the copy takes. Find a couple of safe minutes before pressing F10: the game may look frozen while the copy is written — it is not. Just wait and do not close it.

The F10 button is part of the new control layouts. If you keep your own layout from an earlier version, add the button yourself in the controls editor: input type MNK, binding KEY_F10.

One copy is kept per world; each new one replaces the last. Build 42, single player only.

Additional JVM arguments, e.g.:

• -Xmx2G - allocate 2Gb of memory
• -Xms512M - process starts with 512MB RAM
• -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=120 - target a shorter garbage-collector pause

In theory, it should help when there's not enough RAM. Some arguments are already set by settings.

Values 1–11 are not a scale. Commonly used: 1 (ultra low) and 7 (balanced); mode 1 can crash on empty textures. See the table for the rest.

1. ⚠ all halved
2. ⚠ above 512px halved
3. ⚠ above 256px halved
4. ⚠ above 256px halved, 1024px+ quartered
5. above 256px → 256px
6. above 128px halved, 512px+ → 256px
7. above 512px halved

⚠ also shrinks empty textures — this is where the crashes come from.

8–11 are compatibility modes: they report a larger maximum texture size to the game and save no memory. Not needed for PZ.

Halving a side quarters the memory a texture costs.

Environment variables passed directly to the system before the game starts.

Use to configure renderers, drivers and other components, e.g.:

TU_DEBUG=nogmem
ZINK_DEBUG=norp

Use with caution — incorrect values may cause crashes.

Texture shrinking enabled — it is what keeps the framerate steady on NG_GL4ES. Advanced → Texture shrinking to change it.
On Build 41 this is the right choice: it runs on any GPU and needs no driver setup.\n\nOn Build 42 it does not work — you will get a black screen. There, use NG_GL4ES (any GPU) or ZINK (Adreno).

The default arguments tune the garbage collector only, and are safe on any device — heap size and thread counts are left to the JVM, which scales them to your phone. Build 42 benefits from a stronger set: apply it with one button in Settings → Advanced → JVM arguments.

Recommended for Build 42: caps the Java heap and returns memory to the system, which leaves room for the renderer. In some cases the game may fail to start without some of these parameters. Not for Build 41 — on 4 GB devices it does more harm than good.

This renderer was written for Build 42 and does not work on Build 41 — the game will not start. On Build 41 choose GL4ES.\n\nTexture shrinking has been enabled with it, which is what keeps the framerate steady. Build 42 also wants its own Java arguments — the suggested preset sets everything at once: Settings → Suggested presets.
Build 42 needs tuned JVM arguments — there is a one-button preset for them in the settings.

⚠️ On 4 GB devices the game will run, but not perfectly: Build 42 is not recommended there — play Build 41 and use the optimization mods below (BetterFPS, Every Texture Optimized). They help far more than JVM settings.

"Project Zomboid renders a 190×190 tile zone around the player. This mod reduces the size of this zone and avoids loading unnecessary chunks."
— mod description

Variants:

Renders distant zombies as flat texture animations instead of full models, which helps a lot when a horde is on screen.\n\nSteam Workshop ID: 2970823607. Download the mod, upload the ZIP here and pick a level — it is the number of zombies still drawn as full models. Lower = faster.
Level %1$s not found in this archive. Make sure you picked the RenderLessZombie mod ZIP.

Steam Workshop ID: 2970823607

"When there are too many zombies, they will be rendered as texture animations."
— mod description

The level is how many zombies are still drawn as full 3D models; everything beyond that becomes a cheap flat animation. Available levels: 1, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150 — the mod author recommends 50. The vanilla game has a hard limit of 510.

Installing replaces the zombie/iso classes of the selected instance; the originals are kept next to them as .bak files, so you can restore them by hand if you ever want the stock behaviour.

Fix for Build 41/42 mods with path errors on Android. Known mods: Tsar\'s Common Library (ID: 3402491515), Simple Flashlight on Belt (ID: 3394588830).

Some mods use a folder structure that causes a path conflict on Android. The game ends up looking for files in a doubled path and cannot find them.

This fix installs the mod twice — once with the original folder names, and once with all names in lowercase — so the game finds the files regardless of which path it uses.

Known affected mods:
• Tsar's Common Library — ID: 3402491515
• [B42] Simple Flashlight on Belt — ID: 3394588830

To use: download the mod and load it here.
